measurement: One worker per equation runs the Zoo record builder: local dimension, embedded resolution with both zetas and the pole check, intrinsic resolution, an exhaustive pole-check replay when the quick check is unresolved, then the Milnor and Tjurina numbers. The 50-second wall-clock budget covers every step. Six equations ran at once on an Intel Core i7-1355U (10 cores, 12 threads). A certified case has complete geometry in both modes, both zetas and a verified pole check.
